newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen rising amid horizontal trend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen rising amid horizontal trend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise on Thursday after two virtually flat sessions as the proximity of psychological support at 16,000 should spur some demand, analysts said.
Analysts said, however, the market, currently at 16,222.4 points on the main market's WIG index, was likely to maintain its eight-week sideways drift in longer-term.
They said banks, which rebounded slightly on Wednesday, should extend their modest gains after underperforming the market for the last three months.
